facts.fact: 两名警察进了厨房，Miguel 给其中一人倒了杯水，Caren 坐在吧台凳上看着。
facts.anchor: I sit on a counter stool, watching as Miguel gets a glass of water for one of the two officers now crowded into our kitchen.

facts.fact: Jankowski 警员自我介绍后拿出小本子，说明来电内容是"袭击"，要求从头讲。
facts.anchor: You called nine-one-one about an assault. Let’s start at the beginning, Mrs. Costa.

facts.fact: Caren 说自己只记得昨晚八点左右离开派对，再醒来已是今早，人在离家几条街的别人家门外。
facts.anchor: I remember leaving around eight, but then the next thing I remember it was this morning, and I was blocks away from my house, outside someone else’s house—

facts.fact: Miguel 当着警察的面说出她有安眠药 Ambien 的处方。
facts.anchor: “You have a prescription for Ambien.” He turns to the officer.

facts.fact: Miguel 从垃圾桶里捞出印着 MILLIE’S 的蓝白外卖袋。
facts.anchor: He reaches into the garbage and pulls out the familiar white-and-blue bag with MILLIE’S in print on the side.

facts.fact: Jankowski 撕下钉在袋上的小票，念出地址与"不要奶酪"。
facts.anchor: “It says one Cliff Road, no cheese.”

facts.fact: Miguel 又从垃圾桶里掏出一个空酒瓶，搁在花岗岩台面上。
facts.anchor: He pulls out an empty wine bottle and places it on the granite counter with a thunk.

facts.fact: 章末 Caren 意识到警员不信她，丈夫也不信她。
facts.anchor: And it hits me. Officer Jankowski doesn’t believe me, and neither does my own husband.
